$comment: Hunter-Seeker decision point for Claude Code (Datagoat unit 23). Merge into .claude/settings.json (or settings.local.json). Set HS_API_KEY, HS_AGENT_ID, HS_SOURCE and, when the case is not the session, HS_CASE_ID; HS_FALLBACK names the route to take on any error (default none). The hook script never denies: HS_ROUTE is written to the session's environment for your policy to read. `hs hook <event>` (pip install hunter-seeker) is the same thing in Python.
